test_item:
The Cert Provider feature shall be able to switch verification configurations between the development version software and the product version software.
(Development configuration; the matching certificate chain is deployed)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. Test runner CertProviderServiceManagerTest.apk is installed
3. Certificate assets are available under SecurityAssets/oem-certs/cert-provider/
proc:
1. Confirm the content of /odm/etc/cert_store on the DUT
$ adb shell ls -l /odm/etc/cert_store
2. Run the OpenSSL chain verification of the certificate on the host
$ openssl verify -verbose -CAfile RootCert.pem -untrusted L1.pem -untrusted L2.pem -untrusted L3.pem SAMcert.pem
er:
1. The adb shell ls -l /odm/etc/cert_store output lists the Development certificate chain
2. The openssl command prints "SAMcert.pem: OK" on stdout
design: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
